title: Software Engineer I - Product / Full-Stack
description:
**Location:**
Jayanagar, Bengaluru — in office
  
  
**Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience:**
0–1 years; strong fresh graduates and builders are welcome
  
  
**Compensation:**
the posted range is fixed pay; ESOPs come over and above.
  
  
**About Kulfi**
Kulfi is where couples in India spend time together, even when they can't be in the same place.
  
  
About 100 million unmarried Indian couples don't get to be together most nights. Different cities, different homes, parents around. A phone is all they have. So they join a class just to be near each other, or stay on a one-way call, or watch a movie over video. They do all this for love, and nothing was built for them.
  
  
We are building that. Kulfi is a digital experiences app for couples, and close to a million people already use it. We did not get here by spending. Daily users grew 4x in 30 days this summer. We added 100,000 users in the first 20 days of August without paying for a single ad. 80% of all play happens between 9pm and midnight. That is bedtime, and we own it. We are backed by South Park Commons and by founders and CEOs from Swiggy, Mosaic Wellness, Snitch and Moonshot.
  
  
Next is an AI personalization engine for games. Every couple gets a new game every day, made for them on the spot from what they like. Our team already ships a new game in about two days. No couple should run out of things to do together.
  
  
India has more couples than any other country. We want every one of them on Kulfi.
  
  
We are a small, high-intensity team. Your work will reach real users quickly, and you will be expected to notice what is broken—not wait for someone else to notice it for you.
  
  
The role
  
  
You will build product features end to end across our Flutter app, web surfaces, backend APIs, and data. We do not need you to know every part on day one. We need evidence that you learn quickly, finish what you start, care about the user experience, and understand the code you ship.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Build and ship small product features across app/web, API, and data layers.
* Turn product/design intent into complete user flows, including loading, empty, error, and retry states.
* Debug issues across client, network, backend, and data—not stop at the first layer.
* Write tests, review your own diff, and verify behavior before handoff.
* Read user feedback and product metrics to understand whether a release worked.
* Use AI coding tools to move faster while remaining responsible for every line you ship.
* Ask precise questions, communicate blockers early, and learn from direct feedback.

What we are looking for
  
  

* You have built and shipped at least one real software project, internship deliverable, freelance product, or meaningful open-source contribution.
* You can write readable code and reason through bugs without blindly relying on autocomplete or AI.
* You have worked across at least two layers: mobile/web, backend/API, database, or deployment.
* You care about product details and notice when a technically correct feature creates a bad user experience.
* You move quickly, but you test your work and own mistakes.
* You can explain your contribution, trade-offs, and what you would improve next.
* You are comfortable working in person in Jayanagar, Bengaluru. A computer-science degree is not required. Evidence of building matters more than credentials.

Useful, not mandatory
  
  

* Flutter/Dart and mobile fundamentals.
* State management such as BLoC or Riverpod.
* REST APIs, SQL, caching, queues, or real-time systems.
* Experience with Node.js, Go, Python, Java, or another production backend language.
* CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring, or app-store releases.
* Thoughtful use of Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools.

What success looks like
  
  
Within three months, you can own a scoped feature from problem statement to release, handle the obvious failure states, write useful tests, review your own work, and explain what user signal or metric should improve.
  
  
Interview process
  
  

* Short application review based on shipped work.
* 15–20 minute screening call.
* 75-minute practical product-engineering interview combining a project deep dive, live task, self-review, changed requirement, and product/UX discussion.
* 30-minute founder and mutual-expectations conversation.

We allow AI tools during the practical exercise. You must disclose how you used them and be able to explain and defend the final code.
  
  
Please answer the application questions yourself. Clear and specific beats polished and generic.

description:

**Compensation:**
the posted range is fixed pay; ESOPs come over and above.
  
  
**About Kulfi**
Kulfi is where couples in India spend time together, even when they can't be in the same place.
  
  
About 100 million unmarried Indian couples don't get to be together most nights. Different cities, different homes, parents around. A phone is all they have. So they join a class just to be near each other, or stay on a one-way call, or watch a movie over video. They do all this for love, and nothing was built for them.
  
  
We are building that. Kulfi is a digital experiences app for couples, and close to a million people already use it. We did not get here by spending. Daily users grew 4x in 30 days this summer. We added 100,000 users in the first 20 days of August without paying for a single ad. 80% of all play happens between 9pm and midnight. That is bedtime, and we own it. We are backed by South Park Commons and by founders and CEOs from Swiggy, Mosaic Wellness, Snitch and Moonshot.
  
  
Next is an AI personalization engine for games. Every couple gets a new game every day, made for them on the spot from what they like. Our team already ships a new game in about two days. No couple should run out of things to do together.
  
  
India has more couples than any other country. We want every one of them on Kulfi.
  
  
Our backend sits underneath a private, real-time, two-person product. Reliability, latency, data correctness, and safe iteration matter—but so does shipping the smallest thing that creates user value.
  
  
The role
  
  
You will be the backend-heavy engineer who can still cross the stack. You will own APIs, data models, production reliability, debugging, and system evolution, while making scoped Flutter/web changes when that is the fastest way to deliver or diagnose a feature.
  
  
This is not an infrastructure-only role. You will work directly with founders, product, design, and less-experienced engineers. You should be willing to challenge a weak idea, propose a better one, and then help ship it.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Design, build, and operate backend services, APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows.
* Own reliability: tests, observability, alerts, migrations, safe rollouts, rollback plans, and incident follow-through.
* Debug production behavior using evidence across client, network, services, cache/queues, and data.
* Make pragmatic architecture decisions for current scale while leaving a credible path to 10× growth.
* Partner with product and design on scope, UX implications, success metrics, and rollout.
* Make scoped changes in Flutter or web when needed to complete a feature or investigate an issue.
* Review code and technical proposals; help junior engineers improve judgment and self-review.
* Use AI tools to accelerate delivery without outsourcing understanding, security, or accountability.

What we are looking for
  
  

* Roughly 3–4 years building and operating production software; strong evidence matters more than exact tenure.
* Deep experience in at least one backend language and framework.
* Strong fundamentals in API design, relational data modeling, concurrency, caching/queues, and failure handling.
* Evidence of owning production incidents, difficult bugs, migrations, or reliability improvements.
* Ability to write maintainable code, meaningful tests, and useful logs/metrics.
* Product judgment: you can connect technical choices to user experience, activation, retention, speed, or cost.
* Enough app/web experience to read, debug, and make scoped changes outside the backend.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including direct but constructive technical pushback.
* Comfort working in person in Jayanagar, Bengaluru.

Useful, not mandatory
  
  

* Flutter/Dart or native iOS/Android fundamentals.
* Real-time multiplayer, chat, WebSockets, event-driven systems, or offline/reconnect behavior.
* Redis, queues, background workers, database partitioning, or high-volume consumer systems.
* Security/privacy experience, including encrypted communication systems.
* Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, tracing, and production capacity planning.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading small technical projects.

What success looks like
  
  
Within three months, you own a backend area in production, have improved one reliability or delivery-speed bottleneck, have led a cross-stack feature through rollout and measurement, and have raised the team's standard for code review, testing, and operational follow-through.
  
  
Interview process
  
  

* Application review based on production ownership and your written answers.
* 15-20 minute screening call.
* 105-minute backend product-engineering interview combining an incident deep dive, system design, live code/debugging, self-review, and a changed requirement.
* 35-minute founder conversation covering product judgment, ownership, technical leadership, and mutual expectations.
* References after mutual intent, with consent.

We allow normal documentation and AI tools. You must explain what the tools produced, what you changed, and how you verified the result.
  
  
Please answer the application questions yourself. Clear and specific beats polished and generic.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Engineer based in India.**
As a Data Engineer, you will design and develop specialized data solutions that support healthcare, clinical research, and biopharmaceutical operations. You will work at the intersection of data engineering, healthcare interoperability, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven automation. Your responsibilities will include integrating complex medical data sources, standardizing healthcare information, and building secure, reliable data processing pipelines. You will contribute to the implementation of compliant architectures for regulatory documentation and automated quality control. The role also involves developing custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and orchestration layers to connect fragmented clinical and biopharma data ecosystems. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and building scalable, secure, and accurate data solutions. You will work in a remote environment where innovation, technical excellence, and collaboration are essential.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain robust data engineering pipelines for healthcare, clinical, and biopharmaceutical data processing, extraction, transformation, and normalization.
* Implement specialized healthcare data integration solutions, including DICOM metadata extraction and vectorization using tools such as dcm2bq, and integrate with Picture Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS) and Vendor Neutral Archives (VNA).
* Develop and optimize automated medical coding pipelines that support accurate, traceable coding workflows using standards such as ICD-10, CPT, FHIR, and HL7.
* Build and maintain regulatory-compliant data architectures that align with GxP requirements and 21 CFR Part 11, supporting automated regulatory document drafting, validation, and quality control processes.
* Develop custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) toolsets and secure agent orchestration layers to enable controlled access to siloed clinical and biopharmaceutical data sources.
* Establish data validation, quality assurance, and monitoring mechanisms to maintain data integrity, consistency, security, and reliability across integrated systems.
* Collaborate with technical and domain stakeholders to translate complex healthcare interoperability and regulatory requirements into effective engineering solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve data processing efficiency, interoperability, automation, and system performance while maintaining compliance with applicable standards and regulations.

**Requirements**

* At least 6 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Hands-on experience with healthcare-specific data extraction, transformation, normalization, and interoperability tools, particularly dcm2bq and DICOM metadata processing.
* Practical knowledge of PACS and VNA archive integration and experience working with medical imaging data ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of healthcare data standards, including FHIR, HL7, ICD-10, and CPT, with experience developing automated medical coding or related healthcare data processing pipelines.
* Demonstrated experience designing or implementing GxP-compliant architectures and systems aligned with 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, particularly for regulatory documentation and quality control workflows.
* Deep familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including the development of custom MCP tools and secure orchestration layers for AI-enabled data access and processing.
* Understanding of clinical and biopharmaceutical data environments, including the challenges associated with fragmented data sources, interoperability, security, and regulatory compliance.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to design reliable, scalable, and maintainable data solutions for complex technical requirements.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a remote environment.
* A strong commitment to data accuracy, security, regulatory compliance, continuous improvement, and responsible automation.

**Benefits**

* Remote work: Flexibility to work remotely from India.
* Contract opportunity: A contract-based engagement offering the opportunity to contribute specialized data engineering expertise.
* Technical challenges: Exposure to advanced healthcare interoperability, medical imaging data, regulatory systems, and AI-driven automation.
* Specialized expertise: Opportunities to apply and deepen knowledge of MCP, FHIR, HL7, DICOM, and regulated data architectures.
* Professional growth: Experience working on complex technology solutions at the intersection of healthcare, data engineering, and artificial intelligence.
* Inclusive workplace: A commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and creating an environment where professionals from different backgrounds can contribute and thrive.

In this role, you will manage a high-impact engineering team responsible for delivering advanced detection capabilities, classification systems, and APIs that help enterprises navigate an increasingly automated internet. You will guide the product from beta through general availability and commercial launch, ensuring exceptional detection accuracy, reliability, and scalability. Combining strategic leadership with strong technical judgment, you will establish quality-driven engineering practices and champion an AI-native development model powered by coding agents and automated reviews.
